blocks.html: As some men build great empires, for most of us, the first real measure of success is finding a home to call our own. Self-made billionaire and industry titan John Gokongwei recently marked his homecoming to the island that first gave him a chance for profitable opportunities, with a progressive mixed-use development in an address that perfectly captures the optimistic spirit of the country’s foremost city.

Now, the new Robinsons Galleria Residences raises the sails for the finest dwellings in the island capital of Cebu, by celebrating its glorious past, its multi-faceted present, and its promising future. Situated in the main avenue of Gen. Maxilom, the new Galleria Residences finds itself at the center of progress in the Visayan region; a stone’s throw away from Cebu’s leading hospitals, universities, key commercial areas, and thriving business developments.

The new Galleria Residences merges the best of both worlds in offering the most comprehensive living appointments in the Visayan heartland, with country-club like accommodations that maximize the calming island life, and luxurious, modern amenities that encourage the limitless possibilities of a dynamic cosmopolitan lifestyle.

Designed by award-winning architecture firm, Asya Design Partner, the 6,600 square-meter property, punctuated by the three gleaming residential towers of Galleria Residences with over 750 well-appointed units, will stand as a testament to the region’s cosmopolitan way of life. Its stately entrance lobby serves as a gallery for world-class Cebuano craftsmanship, found in elegant furnishing and accoutrements. Each studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom suite, is intelligently laid out with the luxury of space and utmost comfort as top of mind. Generous balconies that open<span style="text-decoration: line-through">s</span> up to the sea breeze and mesmerizing view of the Cebu Strait, the bustling skyline of the Cebu business district, or the landmark lifestyle haven that is the new Robinsons Galleria Cebu.

With Robinsons Galleria Cebu as its commercial ancho<span style="text-decoration: line-through">r,</span> bringing the best international labels, the most celebrated homegrown businesses, the finest wining and dining selections, and the retail excellence of key Robinsons brands right at its doorstep, the new Galleria Residences encourages a fresh and progressive way of metropolitan living, where inspirations and aspirations could be realized and experienced all in the unique Cebuano brand of convenience and class. Each of the Galleria Residences unit has a quick and secured access from the basement level of the residential towers towards the mall, while thoughtful retail and service boutiques could be found at the ground level that will to cater to the complete, round-the-clock living requirements of its residents.

Yet, what set the new Galleria Residences apart from other high-rise developments in the area are the lifestyle amenities that defy condominium living expectations. Among its three residential towers is a diverse mix of 30 indoor and outdoor facilities that match even the plushest country clubs. Found indoors in the shared podium floor are a spa and sauna, various fitness stations, a private theatre, game room, entertainment halls, children’s playroom, wine bar, game room, and function rooms that cater to a wide variety of emergent lifestyles. While found in its lushly landscaped outdoor areas are a resort-type pool, outdoor playground, a sky deck, and an open lounge that greatly invite a relaxing respite for its residents or a refreshing and a rewarding way to welcome visiting guests.

With amenities beyond compare and a life above the ordinary, the new Galleria Residences promises a whole new lifestyle and living at the heart of Metropolitan Cebu. With a progressive location, plush living arrangements, and a promising community powered by one of the country’s most accomplished developers, the new Galleria Residences certainly prove just how it is growing to be Cebu’s prime-most address.
